item.title: Border 2 show cancelled in Valsad as ceiling collapses at multiplex; no casualties
item.description: A potential major accident was narrowly averted at Rajhans Multiplex in Valsad after a portion of the auditorium ceiling collapsed just before the screening of Border 2. The incident occurred while entry for the 9:00 a.m. show was underway, moments before the film was scheduled to begin.According to media reports, a section of the POP (Plaster of Paris) ceiling located near the front of the screen suddenly fell inside Screen 1. item.title: Salman Khan secures interim order against Abhinav Kashyap in defamation suit: Reports
item.description: A Mumbai civil court has temporarily restrained filmmaker Abhinav Kashyap and others from making or publishing any statements against Bollywood star Salman Khan and his family while hearing a defamation lawsuit filed by the actor.
